decisionsTitle: Columns can be hidden: a «Coloane» menu on every backoffice table, without a data grid (amending §652)
decisionsSection: **The owner, 2026-10-04:** «având MUI data grid pot oricând să afișez sau să ascund coloane». What he wants is to show and hide a backoffice table's columns at will. §652 gave him resizable columns inside `AdminTable` without the grid; this pays the second ask the same way, on the same server-rendered table, with no dependency. **Decision.** - Every table built on `AdminTable` carries «Coloane» / "Columns": a small icon button (`ViewColumn`, 44 px, named «Coloane») in the actions' heading, or, on a list without row verbs, on the line under the table beside the reset. It opens an MUI `Menu`: one `menuitemcheckbox` per column that may be hidden (a `Checkbox` inside, the column's heading as its name), then «Arată toate coloanele» / "Show all columns", greyed while nothing is hidden. The menu stays open while columns are ticked; Escape closes it; the menu is named by its button (`aria-labelledby`). Until the island hydrates, and with JavaScript off, an empty box of the button's size holds its place in the heading, so the layout that runs at hydration already counts it and the button that replaces it moves no column and wraps under no heading. It is a client island (`ColumnVisibility`) that receives the table's id and, per column, its key, its heading and whether it is essential — strings and a flag, never a row (`AGENTS.md` §14.5). - **Essential columns cannot be hidden**: the first column (the row's name), the phone layout's headline (`primary`), and any column a list marks `essential` — the state on the events, pages, albums, staff, registrations and legal lists. They have no checkbox; the menu names them under the list, «Mereu afișate: …» with their headings, a line with `role="none"` that the arrows skip. The row verbs' column is never a column key, so it is never offered. A table therefore always keeps a column to read a row by. The server marks them on the `` (`data-column-essential`), so the script and the islands honour the rule whatever storage says. - **The same store as the widths**: `localStorage`, per browser and per table, under `br.table..hidden` beside `br.table..widths` — a list of column keys, read defensively (anything but an array of keys is nothing), the entry removed when nothing is hidden. A storage that refuses to write keeps the change for the page, an emptied list too, so «Arată toate coloanele» is not undone by what storage still says (§652's rule). - **The same pre-paint script**: before it lays out the widths, the inline script after `` reads the hidden keys and appends one `
changelogLine: - **«Coloane» on every backoffice table** — a menu in the actions' heading shows and hides columns, one checkbox each and «Arată toate coloanele»; the name and the state always stay. Remembered per table in this browser, hidden before the first paint like the widths, undone by «Lățimi și coloane implicite»; the phone layout and the exports keep every column. No data grid. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a backoffice list at `md` and up with JavaScript on, when «Coloane» (a named 44-px icon button in the actions' heading, or under a list without row verbs, whose place a box of its size holds before hydration) is opened, then it lists one checkbox menu item per column except the essential ones — the first column, the phone's headline and the state — which it names as always shown, plus «Arată toate coloanele»; unticking hides that column's `<col>`, heading and cells and its resize edge, keeps its stored width for when it returns, lays the remaining columns out again, and is kept for that table in that browser (`br.table.<id>.hidden`; for the page alone when storage is refused) until it is ticked again, «Arată toate coloanele» or «Lățimi și coloane implicite» (shown only while a width is stored or a hideable column of that table is hidden); with JavaScript off and on the phone layout no menu is drawn and every column shows; the exports keep their columns; the island receives the table's id and each column's key, heading and essential flag, never a row (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a backoffice table with hidden columns, when its page loads, then they are hidden from the first paint — the inline script after the table writes one `<style data-column-hidden="<id>">` into `<head>` (`display: none` by position for each hidden, non-essential column) before it measures the widths — and once the page hydrates the islands keep that style, rewriting it on every change (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Coloane» shows and hides a backoffice table's columns, without a data grid
